source: GSC Performance-on-Search export, ~3-month window ending 2026-06-29 (reporting date 2026-07-06)
method: Rows classified as location-matrix (/locations/{city}/{service}/) or blogs-taxonomy (/blogs/**), deduped across www/non-www host variants by summing clicks/impressions per path. action=keep-review if clicks>0 (still very low absolute volume, needs individual judgment when that page is built), action=redirect-to-hub if 0 clicks in the window (no measurable search equity to protect).
